podcast.body: Robin Lamont sang the lead on "Day by Day" from the musical *Godspell*. This song spent 14 weeks on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1972, peaking at number 13 in the last week of July of that year. "Robin Lamont singing the lead on Day by Day from God's spell."
